Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 24: the slip of [[Hopping Mad (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on non-[Episode I] C-3PO. Once per turn, you may ▲ How Did We Get Into This Mess?, Mantellian Savrip, Thank The Maker, or We're Doomed. If C-3PO present at a battleground, Savrip is [Immune to Alter]. Thank The Maker is a Used Interrupt and treat "5" in its game text as "3".”), word for word the text of [[Hopping Mad (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Source SHA-256: <code>bb70257deeb8f4e3a728b1dc233dca01e96e3f6b8124e95ed04ad3a8f75e98d3</code>. Crop rectangle in PDF points: <code>[214, 574, 398, 662]</code>, rendered at 200 dpi (11 November 2026, batch R8-B3).
